facts.text: Back bacon on the barbie and a two four in the fridge. Bob's already had three of the snacks.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. 'On the barbie' is Australian, not Bob and Doug. Doug's real line at the brewery counter is 'That means you owe us a free case.'.
facts.fix: That means you owe us a free case.

fix_note.text: That means you owe us a free case.

vibe.verdict: Great poster and a proper brewery bar, but it misses the dead mouse, the flying dog and the beer tank.
